- Please include whoever will own procurement and security (CISO/infosec) so we can address audit and deployment constraints live.

1) Wed Aug 4 — 10:00–11:00
2) Thu Aug 5 — 13:00–14:00

If neither day works, propose at most two alternate windows and we’ll try to land the meeting. I attached a short agenda and proposed attendee list.

Quick asks before the deep dive:
- Could you share your SOC questionnaire or security checklist so we can prep answers in advance?
- Will you need a demo tenant or can we use read-only sample data?
